 2.

RAJU SINGH YADAV S/O SHRI MUNNA SINGH  YADAV, AGED ABOUT 34 YEARS, OCCUPATION-  B U S I N E S S , R/O CHAKPURA AKOLA, THANA  UMRI, DISTRICT BHIND (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI R.S.KUSHWAHA - DEPUTY ADVOCATE GENERAL)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER
1.Petitioner/accused has preferred this petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for fair and impartial investigation.

2 . According to learned counsel for the petitioner, there was some dispute between him and respondent No.2 Raju Yadav over the financial mischief done by Raju Yadav, therefore, he registered a complaint against the respondent No.2 at Police Station Dehat District Bhind under Sections 420, 467, 468 of IPC.
Anxiety of the petitioner is fair investigation.

4. Respondent is directed to undertake just, fair and transparent investigation and investigate all possible suspects in this regard.

5. With the aforesaid direction, this petition stands disposed of.
(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE Ashish*
